Plex Integration

Optional but powerful — NGMS and Plex work together natively.

What the integration does

  • Scan on import — triggers a Plex library scan the moment a file is imported
  • Watchlist sync — automatically adds items from your Plex Watchlist to NGMS
  • Activity view — shows active Plex streams and recently played content in NGMS
  • Plex token auth — optionally authenticate NGMS users via their Plex account

Connecting Plex

1

Settings → Plex → Connect

NGMS will redirect you to plex.tv to authorize the connection. After authorizing, you're returned to NGMS with a Plex token stored.

2

Select your Plex server

If you have multiple Plex servers on the account, select the one you want NGMS to talk to. NGMS communicates directly with the server over the local network (or Plex relay if needed).

3

Map library sections

Tell NGMS which Plex library section corresponds to your series root folder and which to your movies root folder. This is what NGMS targets when triggering a scan after import.

4

Enable Watchlist sync (optional)

Toggle Sync Plex Watchlist. NGMS will poll your Plex Watchlist every 6 hours and add any new items to your library with your default quality profile. Items already in your library are skipped.

Path mapping

NGMS and Plex may see your media at different paths (common in Docker setups). Configure path mappings in the Plex settings to translate between them:

NGMS pathPlex path
/media/tv/data/media/tv
/media/movies/data/media/movies
ℹ
Plex integration is entirely optional. NGMS works fully without it — you'd just trigger Plex scans manually or let Plex's own scheduler find new files.
